text: `list.parallelStream()` is a safe drop-in replacement for `list.stream()` when a pipeline is slow.
explanation: It is safe only if every function in the pipeline is pure and the reduction is associative, and when either fails you get a wrong answer rather than an error — Chapter 31's counter gave 97282, 78637 and 906250 on three runs of the same million elements. It is one word, which is exactly the danger, and the cases where it helps are narrower than they look: large data, expensive per-element work, no shared state.
